review_candidates.title: Information Technology System Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Overview We are looking for an experienced System & Network Administrator to manage and optimize our hybrid IT infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Server Management: Install, configure, and maintain Windows Server environments; administer Domain Controllers, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), DNS, and DHCP. Network Administration: Configure and support network hardware, including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs; maintain secure segmentation and connectivity (VLANs, TCP/I
eligibility_evidence: Role Overview We are looking for an experienced System & Network Administrator to manage and optimize our hybrid IT infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications Relevant professional certifications: Microsoft Certified (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator), CCNA, CompTIA Security+/Network+, or cloud credentials (HCIA/HCIP, Azure, AWS).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements & Qualifications Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in System & Network Administration, with strong specialization in Windows Server and enterprise networking. Networking Expertise: Solid understanding of network fundamentals, including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, subnetting, and network security policies. Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience managing resources on Huawei Cloud (preferred) or public clouds such as Microsoft Azure or AWS. Preferred Qualifications Relevant professional certifications: Microsoft Certified (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator), CCNA, CompTIA Security+/Network+, or cloud credentials (HCIA/HCIP, Azure, AWS).
